## About this home
A bright two-bedroom, one-bathroom unit on the ground floor of a fully renovated duplex in
Little Italy, one of Ottawa's most walkable neighbourhoods, minutes from downtown. It's brand
new since the renovation, so the next tenant is the first to live in it. It's about a
30-second walk to the Corso Italia O-Train station, near Gladstone and Preston.

## Good fit for
- Someone who needs parking for two cars: there are two driveway spots.
- Pet owners: the unit is pet friendly.
- Anyone who wants outdoor space: a large private backyard, rare this close to downtown.
- People who want two bedrooms, or a bedroom plus an office.
- Transit commuters, with the O-Train right around the corner.

## Good to know
- Rent is $2,695 a month. Heat and water are included; the tenant pays hydro.
- In-unit laundry.
- There's no air conditioning. Heating is forced air, natural gas.
- A large unfinished basement gives lots of storage.
- Available immediately.
